messages:
Sophia: Heads-up — saw a wave of negative invoice line amounts in the nightly billing run for ~25 customers after the pricing experiment rollout this morning. NetSuite is rejecting the sync for some invoices. Anyone else seeing this?

billing-bot: nightly-billing-job failed: 03:12 UTC — downstream sync error: netsuite_api 422 \"LINE_TOTAL_MUST_BE_NON_NEGATIVE\" (job id: nb-2026-03-23-03)

Matt: @Sophia thanks, looking. Do you have an example invoice id we can repro with?

Sophia: invoice_3K2a7Y - pasted sample payload below from the webhook that triggered the sync:

```json
{
  \"id\": \"invoice_3K2a7Y\",
  \"customer\": \"cus_9bX\",
  \"lines\": [
    {
      \"type\": \"usage\",
      \"description\": \"api_calls\",
      \"quantity\": 100,
      \"unit_price\": -0.05,
      \"amount\": -5
    }
  ]
}
```

Jordan: I see the same pattern in our queue — price_override for the \"beta-tier\" experiment accidentally set negative rates for incremental usage when start_time < promotion_effective_at. Looks like an edge-case in the pricing service.

Matt: Reproduced locally. Pricing service applied a promo delta of -0.10 to a base rate of 0.05, resulting in -0.05 unit_price, then billing code emitted negative line.

Sophia: NetSuite rejects negative line items; we should convert these to credit memos instead of writing negative invoice lines. For now we need a safe rollback/hotfix to prevent more negative lines.

Jordan: Pushed a hotfix to pricing-service to clamp unit_price >= 0 and added a safeguard in billing-producer: if amount < 0, flag for manual-adjustment instead of emitting negative line. Deployed canary to prod region.

Matt: Can we retry the failed syncs after the clamp? Also need to create an internal ticket for the accounting backfill.

Sophia: Created TICKET-4219: \"Pricing experiment produced negative invoice lines — backfill & NetSuite re-sync\". Priya, can finance create credit memos for the impacted invoices while engineering handles re-emits? :pray:

Priya: I can do a manual backfill for top 10 customers this morning. Need a list of invoice ids + amounts. If it's more than that, we'll coordinate a batch approach with ops.

Sophia: attaching short list of the 25 affected invoice ids in the ticket (TICKET-4219). For the rest, let's wait for the producer to mark and quarantine negative-lines so we can process in bulk.

billing-bot: retry-queue: 25 messages moved to quarantine queue: billing-negative-lines-2026-03-23.

Jordan: Follow-ups: 1) add unit tests for promo math edge-case, 2) add e2e confirm in nightly job to reject negative amounts earlier, 3) run a backfill job to emit credit memos (or create manual journal entries) instead of negative invoice lines.

Matt: I'll coordinate with Priya on the top-10 manual credits and schedule a backfill run after canary looks healthy (waiting on canary metrics).

Sophia: Thanks — update in TICKET-4219 once credits created or backfill scheduled. Also flagging to product to pause further pricing experiments until we have a postmortem and guardrails. :warning:

Priya: Will update ticket when done. If anyone sees customer support pings, escalate to me and I'll prioritize.

Jordan: Postmortem ETA: later today, will include root cause, steps, and a rollout checklist for experiments.

Matt: Good catch, @Sophia. :thumbsup:
